Theme

School & learning

term noun

a part of the school year

also school term, semester, trimester, autumn term, spring term, summer term

modern

Traupman 392

studiōrum spatium

a term at school or university

A plain description from classical words: spatium is a stretch of time (spatium temporis).

Other words

  • 1sēmestre: second e left unmarked. Lewis & Short marks only the first e (sēmestris, from sex and mēnsis); Traupman prints semestre on p. 376 and sēmēstre on p. 392. The length of the second vowel is not settled here.

    sēmestre1, sēmestris n. — a half-year term, a semester

    noun, third declension · also used · modern · Traupman 376, 392; M-O s.v. semester (academic), citing Gauss and Mosellanus’s Paedologia

    The neuter of sēmestris, lasting six months (Cic. Att. 10.8.7; Caes. BC 1.9, Lewis & Short).

See also school, holidays, lesson, class.

SourcesLewis & Short: studium · Lewis & Short: spatium · Lewis & Short: semestris
